name: God Is In Control
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly governs all things with authority and purpose. He directs the steps of His people and establishes His counsel above human plans, ensuring that His will prevails in every situation. Believers are encouraged to be strong and courageous, trusting that the Lord is with them wherever they go, providing light, salvation, and strength that dispels fear. Ultimately, the kingdom belongs to the Lord, who reigns as the supreme governor over all nations and does all that He pleases.
